entry.title: The inside story of Jetpack Compose

media:group.media:title: The inside story of Jetpack Compose
media:group.media:description:
Discover the origin story of Jetpack Compose and how it changed the way Android developers build applications. We discuss the original challenges of unbundling the UI toolkit from the operating system to deliver faster updates. By adopting Kotlin and a declarative approach, the team reduced the boilerplate necessary to build user interfaces. While earlier systems relied heavily on XML, Jetpack Compose shifts to a code-first model for easier iteration. Listen to the team share their insights on modifiers, performance improvements, and the future of Android design.

entry.title: Android XR fireside talk: Building the future of spatial experiences

media:group.media:description:
Tune in on the Android Developers YouTube channel for a fireside chat to learn how to build next-generation spatial experiences with Android XR. Following the launch of Samsung Galaxy XR headset in the UK on July 8th, we will discuss spatial design and immersive experiences, building natively, and also touch on adaptive frameworks that scale seamlessly across the platform. Join Google experts Vinny DaSilva and Stevan Silva alongside Google Developer Experts Ahmed Tikiwa and Julien Salvi, and special guests Karim Morsy (CEO and co-founder of Algoriddim), Colin Yao (CTO at Sphere), and Victor Garcia (Co-Founder and CTO at YBVR).
